class.name: OcgLawBspfunc
class.brief_description: Law Function based on a BSpline curve 1d. Package methods and classes are implemented in package Law to construct the basis curve with several constraints.
class.description: ! Law Function based on a BSpline curve 1d. Package ! methods and classes are implemented in package Law ! to construct the basis curve with several ! constraints.

method.name: NbIntervals
method.description: Returns the number of intervals for continuity <S>. May be one if Continuity(me) >= <S>

method.name: Intervals
method.description: Stores in <T> the parameters bounding the intervals of continuity <S>. The array must provide enough room to accommodate for the parameters, i.e. T.Length() > NbIntervals()

method.name: Trim
method.description: Returns a law equivalent of <me> between parameters <First> and <Last>. <Tol> is used to test for 3d points confusion. It is usfule to determines the derivatives in these values <First> and <Last> if the Law is not Cn.
